name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with Sol-led selective delegation and task-scoped child validation.

interface.shortDescription: Honor primary settings; route routine work to Luna and complex judgment to Terra.
interface.longDescription: Start immediately with the user's primary model and effort. The orchestration skill routes bounded routine work to Luna / Max and judgment-heavy work directly to Terra 6.1 / High, with primary-owned decisions, risk-based verification and high-risk-only fresh Sol review. Auxiliary profiles retain explicit pins, sandbox checks, fail-closed validation and safe installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to carry out the user's task using their selected primary model and effort. Follow the skill's routing, delegation, safety, and acceptance rules without a startup model confirmation or routine route declaration.
